title: HONOURS AND AWARDS ON THE OCCASION OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
body_text:
1.       Following gallantry awards have been conferred to Army personnel on the occasion of Independence Day 2026 :-
Ser No Award Number Remarks 1.1. Kirti Chakra 03 Including 01  Posthumous Citations Attached 1.2. Bar to Shaurya Chakra 01 Citation attached 1.3. Shaurya Chakra 11 Including 01 Posthumous Citations attached 1.4. Bar to Sena Medal (Gallantry) 05 1.5. Sena Medal (Gallantry) 36 Including 05 Posthumous 1.6. Mention-in-Despatch 75
Attached File :-
1. List of Gallantry Awardees 2026 .
2. Citations of Kiriti Chakra, Bar to Shaurya Chakra & Shaurya Chakra Awardees 2026 .
****
Nishant/ Rinku Singh

enrichment.summary: On the occasion of Independence Day 2026, the Ministry of Defence announced gallantry awards for Army personnel, including 3 Kirti Chakras (1 posthumous), 1 Bar to Shaurya Chakra, 11 Shaurya Chakras (1 posthumous), 5 Bars to Sena Medal (Gallantry), 36 Sena Medals (Gallantry, including 5 posthumous), and 75 Mentions-in-Despatch. Citation lists were attached as accompanying files.
enrichment.context: Gallantry awards such as the Kirti Chakra and Shaurya Chakra are peacetime military honours conferred for acts of courage, valour, and sacrifice, ranking alongside the Ashoka Chakra as India's top peacetime gallantry decorations. These are traditionally announced twice a year, on Republic Day and Independence Day, recognising acts performed in counter-insurgency, counter-terrorism, and other operations. While such announcements honour individual valour and reflect ongoing security operations (often in border areas or insurgency-affected regions), they are routine administrative/ceremonial releases without new policy content, and do not typically carry standalone exam significance beyond general awareness of the gallantry award hierarchy.
